quarterly_data.quarter: Tosoh results presentation: Financial Results for the First Three Months of FY2027 (08-04-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Q1 FY2027 (April-June 2026): net sales JPY 274.2 billion against JPY 245.1 billion and operating income JPY 31.2 billion against JPY 16.1 billion, on higher selling prices reflecting the naphtha price rise and overseas market conditions amid Middle East tensions, the weaker yen, a substantial favorable inventory valuation and higher shipments of Value-Added Chemicals and Advanced Materials products.

quarterly_data.quarter: Tosoh results presentation: Financial Results for the First Three Months of FY2027 (08-04-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Advanced Materials segment Q1: net sales JPY 34.3 billion (JPY 30.1 billion a year earlier), operating income JPY 3.2 billion (JPY 2.5 billion). Silica glass shipments for semiconductor applications increased in Japan and East Asia against the backdrop of strong AI-related demand (shipments to North America decreased, overall shipments increased); sputtering target shipments in Japan were unchanged year-on-year while overseas shipments for semiconductor applications increased. Higher shipments of silica glass and other products outweighed higher fixed costs.
quarterly_data.figure: Advanced Materials Q1 net sales JPY 34.3 billion; operating income JPY 3.2 billion

quarterly_data.quarter: Tosoh results presentation: Financial Results for the First Three Months of FY2027 (08-04-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Water Treatment segment Q1: net sales JPY 42.0 billion (JPY 37.8 billion), operating income JPY 6.6 billion (JPY 7.2 billion). The water treatment engineering business kept high net sales in Taiwan, where orders for large-scale semiconductor-related projects continued, while large-scale projects in the U.S. progressed steadily; operating income fell on the absence of highly profitable plant projects of the prior-year quarter and higher personnel and IT costs.
quarterly_data.figure: Water Treatment Q1 net sales JPY 42.0 billion; operating income JPY 6.6 billion

quarterly_data.quarter: Tosoh results presentation: Financial Results for the First Three Months of FY2027 (08-04-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: FY2027 forecast (first issued with these results): net sales JPY 1,170.0 billion and operating income JPY 105.0 billion (FY2026: JPY 1,019.9 billion / JPY 95.5 billion); first half JPY 580.0 billion / JPY 50.0 billion. Advanced Materials is forecast at net sales JPY 143.3 billion (FY2026 JPY 115.3 billion) and operating income JPY 13.7 billion (JPY 6.4 billion), primarily reflecting improved profitability in silica glass and sputtering target associated with the recovery in semiconductor demand; Water Treatment at net sales JPY 200.0 billion and operating income JPY 40.5 billion on steady progress of large-scale overseas advanced semiconductor plant projects and the expansion of the solutions business. Capital expenditures are planned at JPY 96.0 billion (FY2026 JPY 72.7 billion).
